% !tp-example Basic usage
\documentclass{article}
\begin{document}
\wcTpTangram{}
\end{document}

% !tp-example Javascript API
\documentclass{article}
\begin{document}
\wcScript[type=module]|
import "/components/tangram/tangram.js";

const example = document.createDocumentFragment();

const element1 = document.createElement("tp-tangram");
example.append(element1);

document.body.append(example);
|
\end{document}

% !tp-example Named vertices
\documentclass{article}
\begin{document}
\wcTpTangram{
  \wcScript[type=tp/tangram]|
# Corners of a square of side 4
point A = (0, 0)
point B = (4, 0)
point C = (4, 4)
point D = (0, 4)

# Shared landmarks
point O = midpoint(A, C)
point E = midpoint(B, C)
point F = midpoint(C, D)
point G = midpoint(B, O)
point H = midpoint(O, C)
point I = midpoint(O, D)

# The seven pieces, described by their boundary vertices
triangle A B O
triangle A O D
triangle E C F
triangle B E G
triangle O H I
square O G E H
parallelogram D F H I
|
}
\end{document}
